aspects.rationale: [PROPOSED / REQUIRES VALIDATION] FAIRNESS: observed disparity gap=0.283. Heuristic metric-to-O/S/D mapping — not validated science.
[PROPOSED / REQUIRES VALIDATION] ROBUSTNESS: clean_accuracy=0.868, robust_accuracy=0.858, degradation_ratio=0.989. Heuristic metric-to-O/S/D mapping — not validated science.

The model card declares an apache-2.0 license and provides extensive documentation (11,095 chars), but triggers flags unpinned_revision and empty_file_list. Probe checks recorded revision_pinned as false (revision=local) and files_listed as false, triggering risks I-INT-REV-UNPINNED and I-INT-MANIFEST-MISSING. Without pinned cryptographic SHA identifiers or recorded file listings, model artifact integrity cannot be verified against tampering or drift. Downstream users loading the model locally can easily observe the unpinned state, though cryptographic verification remains unavailable.

Although the automated probe flagged missing_intended_use and missing_training_data (3/5 coverage ratio, triggering E-DOC-INCOMPLETE), the card body contains rich, model-specific documentation across non-standard headings. It specifies exact transformer backbones (bert-base-uncased, roberta-base, xlm-roberta-base), original Kaggle dataset sources (Wikipedia Comments, Civil Comments), and detailed label taxonomies covering 9 identity categories. Furthermore, the 'Limitations and ethical considerations' section concretely explains false-positive risks from humorous or self-deprecating profanity and cites three specific academic papers on racial bias. Intended use is explicitly defined for research, fine-tuning, and aiding content moderators.

The probe recorded 0/4 required safety disclosure sections present (coverage_ratio 0.0), triggering S-GOV-DISCLOSURE-GAP alongside flags missing_privacy, missing_misuse_risks, missing_security_warnings, and missing_data_disclosure. While the card includes a brief ethical note on demographic bias in toxic language detection, it contains zero governance disclosures covering PII/privacy, data collection consent, adversarial security, or explicit misuse prohibitions. Unaddressed deployment of automated toxicity classification without misuse or privacy guidance risks improper censorship or unvetted handling of sensitive user input. Downstream users reviewing the card can plainly see that dedicated safety, privacy, and security sections are entirely absent.
